name: Rizuhble's Bombing Run McGinnis
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Getting poked out of lane. Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,000 (levels 1-14). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Heavy Barrage T3. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Duration Extender.

items.name: Monster Rounds
items.caption: Temporary, sold when you buy Lightning Scroll later. Until then it speeds up camps: +25% weapon damage and +25% bullet resist against non-hero targets.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 7.3 to Spectral Wall's damage (0.73x scaling).
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Duration Extender completes 4.8k spirit in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Extra Stamina
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 8000 souls (~8.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Duration Extender completes 3,200 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Duration Extender completes 4.8k spirit in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Heavy Barrage: takes 18% off its 200s base cooldown.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Heavy Barrage: its duration-scaled parts (duration 14s, move slow duration 1s) get +22%.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Stamina Mastery completes 2,400 souls on. Upgrade of Sprint Boots (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Stamina Mastery completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,000-24,000 (levels 14-27). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Medicinal Specter T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Spectral Wall, damage) grows from 106 to 142. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Stamina Mastery.

items.name: Stamina Mastery
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Extra Stamina (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Mystic Slow
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 13.2 to Spectral Wall's damage (0.73x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 7,200 to 8,800 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 233s; 20% off is 46.6s per full rotation.

items.name: Debuff Reducer
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 8,000 invested: bonus 42 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 10,400 to 15,200 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 24,000-60,000 (levels 27-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Mini Turret T3, Spectral Wall T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Spectral Wall, damage) grows from 142 to 240.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 12,800 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 21.9 to Spectral Wall's damage (0.73x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 15,200 to 20,000 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Lightning Scroll
items.caption: Heavy Barrage deals damage (damage per rocket), so it applies the item's 0.75s stun after a 3s delay plus 150 damage. Takes spirit from 20,000 to 24,800 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Replaces Monster Rounds: sell it when you buy this.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Heavy Barrage duration (14s), Heavy Barrage move slow duration (1s), Mini Turret turret lifetime (35s). Upgrade of Duration Extender (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Heavy Barrage min distance (8.5m), Heavy Barrage explosion radius (6.5m), Mini Turret turret attack range (40m). Takes spirit from 26,400 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.

items.name: Infuser
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Diviner's Kevlar
items.caption: Casting Heavy Barrage gives a 1,000 barrier and +40 spirit for 20s, available once per ultimate cooldown (155s at your current ultimate tier), so it is a once-per-fight burst of defence. Takes vitality from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 233s of base cooldown across your kit, 155s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Stamina Mastery? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Mystic Slow.
sections.desc: Dying after Stamina Mastery? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Mystic Slow.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: They dive you and you've got no way out.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slows and hexes keep you from getting away.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: Lash ult, Infernus ult. Anything big you can see coming.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
